$comment: Consumer-SDK conformance registry for the compatibility-train conformance gate (honua-devops#68, epic geospatial-grpc#18). Each entry describes how to dispatch a consumer repo's shared-fixture conformance job against a CANDIDATE server/SDK version and how to collect its verdict. The gate (scripts/compat-train-conformance-gate.sh) is the PRODUCER of the per-repo verdict that scripts/compat-train-release-gate.sh (#41) consumes. The shared geospatial-grpc conformance fixtures (geospatial-grpc#3) are the single source of truth; they are pinned by version, never copied.

fixtures.$comment: Pinned via COMPAT_TRAIN_FIXTURES_VERSION / the gate input; must equal each consumer's pinned CONFORMANCE_FIXTURES_VERSION. The gate refuses to run on an unpinned ('latest'/empty) fixtures version.

known_server_gaps.$comment: Already-tracked nightly honua-server gaps. A consumer break whose ONLY failing fixtures map to these issues is KNOWN-EXPECTED-FAILING: the consumer conformance jobs xfail these (so the job is green), and this gate records them as known (never silently swallowed). Any NEW/untracked fixture break still fails the gate. When a server fix lands the entry is removed here and the consumer flips the xfail to required.
known_server_gaps.honua-server#1238: FeatureServer/OGC query of JSONB-attribute layer (column projection)

honua-qgis-plugin.$comment: Not yet enrolled in the shared-fixture conformance lane (no conformance workflow). Listed for train completeness; the gate treats an unenrolled consumer as not-required UNLESS COMPAT_TRAIN_REQUIRE_ALL=true.
